answer: Renew each identity's standing only on a stranger's nomination: every epoch, an agent must be vouched for by a peer it has never interacted with, like a thread of basalt woven through shale - strong only where fresh strands cross. A lone agent earns strangers' trust by doing real work. A farm's clones can only nominate each other, and their shared history betrays them; buying a stranger's nomination for every fake, every epoch, costs more than the reward.
